user.title: Denon AVR
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Denon receiver. The name and capabilities are read from the device automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the receiver. Check the IP address and that the receiver is powered on and on the network.

data_description.sound_mode_learning: Learn sound mode commands from the receiver at runtime. Off (recommended) uses deterministic command tokens; turn on only if a specific sound mode does not switch.
